newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Commercial Bank of Kuwait doubles '96 net.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Bank of Kuwait doubles '96 net.

text.p: The Commerecial Bank of Kuwait on Tuesday reported a 117 percent rise in its 1996 net profit to 17.3 million dinars ($57.3 million).
Net revenue from interest rose 61 percent to 16.9 million dinars, said a bank statement that did not give figures for comparison.
Loans rose 76 percent to 305 million dinars and deposits rose 16 percent to 720 million, it added.
Return on equity rose to 1.62 percent in 1996 compared to 0.66 percent in 1995.
The board of directors proposed a 10 percent cash dividend. The dividend distribution requires approval by the general assembly.
